reviews.text: AJ and his team were awesome to work with, they went above and beyond. Not only did he help me with my project but he helped me plan out the electrical diagram as well. The customer service was second to none if you’re looking for an electrician I fully recommend AJ.

Valencia Electric far exceeded my expectations! They covered up the room they were working in with tarps, so that nothing would get dirty or dusty. They thoroughly showed us how to work our new fan and made sure that we were happy with the way it looked! They provide exceptional service and we will definitely use them again! Thank you Aj!

Valencia Electric did an outstanding job upgrading my electrical panel in my home that's 60 years old. From top to bottom with wiring and rewiring, installing a new electrical panel isn't easy. I was not only impressed and amazed at their quality of work but also their team work, and they did it in a spirit of excellence. I will recommend Valencia Electric to anyone I know, or don't know who seeking a good Electrician. Thank you for a job well done. Derrick &  Alicia.

I received an immediate quote and frank, helpful information to make a good decision on installing a surge protector in our home electrical panel. They came out and did the job quickly with no problems. Communication was great. I'd definitely recommend Valencia Electric. They took $25 off my invoice for this review, but it's an honest one, and I'd have recommended them anyway.

I called to get a quote on troubleshooting a nonworking chandelier and an estimate to upgrade an electrical panel.

Two gentlemen came and were very professional, efficient, and very respectable to my home by covering their feet and using drop cloths under work areas. They explained everything that was completed and what needed to be done for the upgrade.

I 100% recommend Valencia Electric and will most definitely use them for any electrical work, if needed, in the future.

Valencia electric is the only company I call when I need electrical help. They have always been the nicest, reliable and most professional team I have ever worked with. They always take their time and do the highest quality work. AJ and Luis go above and beyond every time they help me with a project. I am so excited about how my new led can lights look and all of the other fixtures that they have helped me hang. They always make sure to give me their professional opinion as well as listening to

I've used Valencia Electric for years and AJ is the only electrician I trust. They did all of the electrical rough and finish out for my
new construction Duplex and continue to do any maintenance repairs that arise. I highly recommend them for all your electrician needs. They are very professional and prompt!

I recently had the pleasure of working with Valencia Electric LLC, and I can confidently say they are the best electric company I've ever dealt with. From start to finish, the experience was exemplary.

The customer service was outstanding—prompt, courteous, and always willing to go the extra mile to ensure my needs were met. The team displayed a high level of professionalism and expertise, addressing all my questions and concerns with patience and clarity.

Exceeded our expectations! We needed our electrical panel serviced quickly and AJ came out same day for the quote and got us in quick for repair services. Amazing customer service and quality work. We highly recommend!

Luis and a young Valencia family member work for almost an entire day. They completely transformed my home from a dark and dated place to a bright and fully-functioning residence with wisdom on ways to save on LED upgrades. Excellent service, and they honored their advertisement on a radio ad! Very honest and compassionate people.

Four years ago we did a whole house renovation.  AJ Valencia took care of all the electrical and we could not have been more pleased.  He and his crew were professional and did a great job.
I have referred him to friends and clients since.  They all have been very pleased with his work.
I highly recommend.

I absolutely recommend this company! Our church building is very large and we needed an electrician for a power outage on the large sign on top of the building. We called Valencia Electric and they fixed the problem the same day, they were very kind and adapted to our needs of our Church. A J Valencia was our technician and we will ask for him for all our calls. Thank you Valecia Electric for helping us, we will be a continuous customer for all our electrical problems in our building and in our

Have an old electrical box that is creating some issues with the AC while we wait to update all of the above. Came out within 24 hours of our call. Assessed the situation. Checked all connections & made adjustments. Very fair price for their work on a terribly hot day. Highly recommend.

Valencia Electric was quick to respond.  We call this past week to assist us with one of our restroom trailers and power shortage.  They came out on short notice, helped us determine the problem and provided a quick solution.  Really appreciate the service.

Mr Valencia has done several projects for us.  In the latest project, he was able to find and fix an issue we were having with a circuit we tripped in almost an instant.  Highly recommend Valencia Electric
Best electric company in Dallas. I’ve used AJ and his team on personal and business projects and they are the best hands down. Fair, efficient and on time.

Good Afternoon AJ, I wanted to thank you again for taking my call last Sunday night, when I told you I was the only house without power and didn't know how it could be an Oncor issue- well your suggestion that it could be the meter was correct. At 2am Monday (4 1/2 hours later) Oncor came, tested and replaced the meter- Voilà all good. I will keep you in mind as a reference if asked about electricians and appreciate the work your team did for my own needs in May 2021.
Have a great Labor Day week
I had Mr. Valencia and his work crew do electrical work at our church. He was timely, professional and courteous. They completed the job ahead of time and cleaned up thoroughly. I give them a 5 star.

AJ has done a ton of work on our 1926 Tudor over the years, and it’s all been exceptional.  He always does what he says he’s going to do for the price he quoted.  He also makes great suggestions for unusual situations.
We have used Valencia Electric for several years. They are prompt, polite and professional!! We will use them for years to come!
Super prompt and professional service! We're used them several times and will again! Highly recommend!!
Danny was very professional and pleasant with the delays that occurred.
Diagnosed the problem over the phone.
AJ and Luis are fantastic

Excellent service, very professional and attentive. I received a response and service the next day. I called two other places, but they didn't even answer. Valencia was respectful, explained everything, answered all my questions, and I saved his information for future electrical repair needs. THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING.
